info.title: API-DocTest-List Telecom Sim Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status Retrieval API allows users to efficiently access current status information of telecom SIM cards. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to monitor and manage SIM card status, which is crucial for operational efficiency and customer service. Typical consumers include telecom operators and service managers seeking to ensure that SIM cards are active and functioning correctly. This API supports real-time status updates, facilitating proactive decision-making and timely interventions.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the SIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current operational status of the SIM, including any relevant information about its connectivity, registration, and any alerts or issues that may affect its functionality.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the SIM card operations. It should encapsulate all necessary parameters to accurately fetch the desired information from the server.

200.description: The request was successful and the current status is returned.

ListTelecomSimStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations GET endpoint, which is expected to be a string.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier corresponding to the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation result.

audit.description: Audit details related to the operation.

ListTelecomSimStatusResponse_200.description: A schema representing the response of the status operation for a GET request.

createdBy.description: The user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing audit information of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 represents an immediate response.
